mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of future rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when inflation rises >0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS labor claims coincides with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as markets interpret stronger labor demand as a growth signal.
failure_condition: Over 100 observations, monthly PAYEMS increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index suggests supply-side weakness, leading to a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate slower growth.
failure_condition: 60-day rolling window shows INDPRO declines are not associated with statistically significant negative 60-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both GDPC1 and HOUST retail sales with no change in FEDFUNDS imply strong demand, producing a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: In 100+ test windows, simultaneous GDPC1 and HOUST up moves without FEDFUNDS change do not predict positive 20-day returns (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 5% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is expected to be negative as markets price in higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Over 200 episodes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% for 3 months (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE unemployment coincides with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as lower labor market friction supports market optimism.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in a month
failure_condition: Over 200 monthly changes, UNRATE drops >0.2pp are not followed by positive 5-day returns (Pearson r < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in RSAFS industrial production index and INDPRO manufacturing index (interaction) predict a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to supply-side contraction.
failure_condition: In 80+ interaction windows, combined RSAFS and INDPRO declines do not precede negative 20-day forward returns (IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of steady FEDFUNDS (no month-to-month change), the S&P 60-day forward return is positive as markets anticipate a pause in rate hikes and price in future growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains flat for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 50 pause episodes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than average during steady FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).
